---
title: Grana ice cream
id: MAR-0044
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 0.5 g fresh cream
- 300 g grated Grana Padano
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Pour the cream into a saucepan, salt it, and add the Grana Padano gradually, whisking.
2. Cook in a bain-marie, always whisking, until the Grana Padano has melted and the mixture is soft.
3. Let it cool and put the ice cream in the freezer for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.
4. Serve the ice cream with bread croutons.
